title: Alien waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#3cd14a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#48e85a'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#7dff8c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#3cd14a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#48e85a'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='40' y1='14' x2='34' y2='4' stroke='#2cab38' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='4' r='4' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='14' x2='66' y2='4' stroke='#2cab38' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='4' r='4' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#102a14'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='31' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#102a14'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M43 41 Q50 48 57 41' stroke='#102a14' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q22 70 24 80' stroke='#3cd14a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='82' r='5' fill='#48e85a'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <path d='M70 60 Q82 52 84 38' stroke='#3cd14a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='36' r='6' fill='#48e85a'/>
  <!-- fingers for wave -->
  <line x1='85' y1='36' x2='91' y2='30' stroke='#48e85a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='85' y1='36' x2='92' y2='38' stroke='#48e85a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='42' y1='94' x2='42' y2='98' stroke='#2cab38' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='94' x2='58' y2='98' stroke='#2cab38' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
